title: More People on Bikes
text:
Local newspapers often publish reports on public health. A recent report from the city council described a rise in the number of cyclists. According to the authors, more people now ride bicycles to work because new bike lanes were built last year. The report also noted that air quality improved in the areas near the lanes.

However, the authors warned that the findings are preliminary. The sample included only residents of the central district, so the results may not represent the whole city. They recommended a larger survey before the council makes any decisions about further investment.

questions.text: According to the report in paragraph one, why do more people now ride bicycles?
options: Bike lanes were built last year.

questions.text: What did the authors recommend in paragraph two?
options: A larger survey before any decisions.
Stopping all investment in the city.

questions.text: Why might the results not represent the whole city?
options: The survey covered only one district.
The authors deliberately lied about the data.
The council refused to help with the survey.

questions.text: What can be inferred about the authors' attitude toward their own findings?
options: They are completely certain of them.
They do not care about them.

paragraph_translations: Jornais locais frequentemente publicam relatórios sobre saúde pública. Um relatório recente do conselho municipal descreveu um aumento no número de ciclistas. Segundo os autores, mais pessoas agora andam de bicicleta para o trabalho porque novas ciclovias foram construídas no ano passado. O relatório também observou que a qualidade do ar melhorou nas áreas próximas às ciclovias.

No entanto, os autores alertaram que as conclusões são preliminares. A amostra incluía apenas moradores do distrito central, então os resultados podem não representar a cidade inteira. Eles recomendaram uma pesquisa maior antes que o conselho tome qualquer decisão sobre novos investimentos.
